خَصْلٌ A stake, or wager, laid in a shootingmatch. (S, TA.) One says, أَحْزَرَ خَصْلَهُ and أَصَابَ خَصْلَهُ [He won his stake, or wager;] he overcame (S, K, TA) in the case of laying stakes or wagers [in a shooting-match]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And A thing for which persons contend together in a game of hazard. (Har p. 640.) ―
-b3- See also خَصْلَةٌ, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
